responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE pass for conditional dead call elimination and errno-preserving builtin shrinking. The pass scans SSA CFGs for builtin math/library calls whose error cases are rare, synthesizes argument-range or NaN-based guards, optionally replaces result-producing builtins with cheaper internal_fn calls plus conditional errno-setting calls, and updates CFG and virtual SSA state after inserting the new guarded control flow.
